settings.title: Settings
@settings.title: Title of the settings dialog (File menu, Settings...)
settings.language.label: Language
@settings.language.label: Label of the drop-down list of interface languages; the list itself shows each language in its own language
settings.language.hint: The language of the program's interface. Maps, projects and exports do not depend on it; the choice is kept for the next start.
settings.hide_dlc.hint: Hides objects and road types that belong to a DLC in every list but the map's own, so the map needs only the base game and freeware. {origin} Folders of add-ons bought outside Steam can be marked as DLC with the tag button in the object library.
@settings.language.changed: Status message after choosing a language; {language} is the language's name in its own language, for example Deutsch
